The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] '''Chad''' (also known as '''Chadra'''<ref name="Play It Again, Figrin D'an: The Tale of Muftak and Kabe">{{StoryCite|story=Play It Again, Figrin D'an: The Tale of Muftak and Kabe|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> or '''Chad III'''<ref name="Children of the Jedi" /><ref name="Spores">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Spore Clouds}}</ref>) was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] race. It was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], more specifically in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].

==Description==
[[File:Chad.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A typical scene on Chad.]]
Chad was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the blue-white [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Chad (star)|Chad]]<ref name="GG4" /> in the [[Chad system/Legends|Chad system]]<ref name="UAA31" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and was within the area known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TUR11">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> Chad occupied an unusual elliptical orbit, which caused uncertainty as to whether it was the third or fourth planet from its star.<ref name="EGAS" /> Chad's [[Standard day/Legends|day]] lasted twenty [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] and its [[Standard year/Legends|year]] lasted 380 local [[Standard day/Legends|days]].<ref name="AFTGP" /> Chad was a terrestrial world that possessed a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], a hot climate, a moist hydrosphere, and standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]<ref name="AFTGP" /> and was orbited by nine small [[Moon/Legends|moons]],<ref name="GG4" /> which created a complex,<ref name="TUR11" /> gentle, and pulsing system of tides.<ref name="GG4" />

[[Water/Legends|Water]] covered three-fourths of Chad's surface, and its terrain featured bayous, marshes, and bogs.<ref name="GG4" /> Large [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and ridge-like, mountainous continents divided by broad band of tidal marshes dominated the planet's geography, and long, broad currents existed in the deep oceans of Chad.<ref name="AFTGP" /> Narrow mountains were the only areas on the planet that were considered dry;<ref name="GG4" /> even the highlands experienced regular rainfall and were covered in clinging foliage. On Chad, depth and height were considered to be more meaningful terms than land and water. Wetlands appeared beginning in foothills and lowlands, bogs appeared at moderate elevations, and deep swamps were present along coasts. Tens of thousands of square kilometers of shallowly-submerged land tapered off into moderate seas, then into deep ocean.<ref name="AFTGP" />

Rays from Chad's sun warmed the planet's surface to an average of 89 standard degrees, though recorded temperatures ranged from 20 to 122 standard degrees.<ref name="GG4" /> The relatively high mean temperature on Chad, combined with<ref name="AFTGP" /> nearly absent axial tilt, allowed the planet's climate to remain fairly uniform with little variation through seasons,<ref name="GG4" /> although polar areas froze in winter and equatorial [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] steamed in summer.<ref name="AFTGP" /> Its sky was turquoise in [[Color/Legends|color]] and its seas were volatile,<ref name="GG4" /> with hurricanes and tsunamis occurring frequently;<ref name="TUR11" /> hurricanes moved through the deep ocean on a nearly [[Standard month/Legends|monthly]] basis.<ref name="AFTGP" />

Only a few areas of land on Chad were considered habitable, and fauna of note was scarce even in those areas. The world's government consisted of anarchistic clans and local ranches. A pre-industrial world,<ref name="AFTGP" /> Chad was rich in [[Methane/Legends|methane]] fuels,<ref name="GG4" /> and although [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and traders brought some high technology to Chad, the world was considered to be technologically primitive.<ref name="UAA31" /> It exported [[bildog]] meat, [[proop]] meat, and unusual mechanisms while importing homestead supplies.<ref name="AFTGP" />

==History==
The native [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]], an arboreal race, dwelt in simple dwellings in the tops of the bayous' [[cyperill tree]]s. They did not bother to make elaborate homes, as they knew their dwellings could be destroyed at any time by the hurricanes and tsunamis which their planet was prone to.<ref name="GG4" /> [[Callista Ming|Callista]] grew up on Chad with her family,<ref name="MIS36">{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime}}</ref> who worked as deep-sea ranchers on the world's [[algic current]],<ref name="NEGC37">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> herding and cultivating [[wander-kelp]], until [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]] arrived around [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]] to [[Jedi training/Legends|educate]] her in the ways of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="MIS36" />

Chad was not a member world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="NEGC37" /> In [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]], the fifth "death wave" to be recorded in Chadra-Fan history occurred when ocean floor quakes on Chad created massive tidal waves. Hundreds of thousands of Chadra-Fan were [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="EGAS" /> and much of their civilization was destroyed.<ref name="GG4" /> By [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Chad was the dairy capital of the galaxy, due to the large herds of [[Milk/Legends|milk]]-producing [[lactil]]s on the planet. However, because the lactils produced so much [[Methane/Legends|methane]], Chad's atmosphere was often subjected to intense storms as a result of the greenhouse effect it produced.<ref name="QotE" />

==Locations==
Chad had no known permanent local landing facilities and no landing facilities that were sanctioned by the Galactic Empire, but the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] would occasionally erect landing platforms in hopes of attracting traders from off-world.<ref name="AFTGP" />

==Inhabitants==
[[File:ChadraFan-SoT.png|thumb|right|200px|Chadra-Fan were native to Chad.]]
Chad was the only inhabited planet in its system,<ref name="GG4" /> with a population that included twenty million Chadra-Fan and 15,000 [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="AFTGP" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Chadra-Fan,<ref name="GG4" /> a [[Rodent/Legends|rodentine]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="AFTGP" /> whose tendency to emigrate to<ref name="TUR11" /> and gravitate towards drier worlds and fear of water-related [[Death/Legends|death]] stemmed from the violent nature of Chad's seas.<ref name="GG4" /> Many Chadra-Fan were aware of the existence of life beyond Chad, although they lacked detailed knowledge on the subject.<ref name="AFTGP" /> Series of natural disasters on Chad forced the Chadra-Fan to focus on the necessity of survival.<ref name="UAA31" /> An unchartered colony of loosely-connected, hardy, and individualistic homesteaders and ranchers lived on Chad's oceans. These mostly Human groups gathered in small, nomadic fleets of barges and herded semi-domesticated bildogs and proops.<ref name="AFTGP" /> The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Callista Ming was one of the Humans born on Chad. The Human colonists lived in oceanic ranches aboard large [[ranch-ark]]s.<ref name="Children of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chad's first mention in ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'' calls places the planet in the fourth position in its system, while the later novel [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] calls it Chad III. [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']] later resolved the problem by introducing Chad's eccentric orbit, which makes it either the third or fourth planet in the system at different times in its year.<ref name="EGAS" />

''[[Play It Again, Figrin D'an: The Tale of Muftak and Kabe]]'' refers to the Chadra-Fan [[Kabe/Legends|Kabe]] as a native of the planet Chadra. This may be an alternate name for Chad, or a separate Chadra-Fan colony. This would have to be in another system, since ''Galaxy Guide 4'' points out that Chad is the only inhabited planet in its system.

The [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 19|nineteenth issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine mistakenly refers to Chad as "Chadra-Fan."<ref name="FF19">{{FactFile|19|MOU 1-2|MSE-6 'Mouse Droid'}}</ref>
